description: The Feb 24 Ministry gathering is reported as “several hundred” by TV3 (S004); Rokiškio Sirena independently confirms regional participation but gives only a local delegation subset, not total turnout. No second independent overall crowd estimate was found.

description: Feb 6 reports actions at private dairy processors and shopping-center headquarters (S005), while Feb 24 documents a protest at the Agriculture Ministry (S004,S006). Search output also surfaced later farmer mobilization; the captured evidence does not establish whether these are one coordinated continuous campaign or separate episodes.
required_followup: Contemporaneous reporting identifying organizers and explicit links among the separate dates/actions; do not transfer turnout estimates or continuity.

description: Ten captured English and Lithuanian searches covered national news, Vilnius, the Feb 24 Ukraine solidarity events, farmers, prices, public-sector/workers, and Feb 16. Six opened source cards include national and regional reporting. This is a bounded public-web sweep, not a systematic archive or exhaustive province-by-province review; Q006 LRT and Q009 Delfi search actions were robots-blocked and remain action-scoped restrictions.
required_followup: Reviewer may assess whether additional independently permitted local/regional reporting would materially improve coverage; do not retry or bypass blocked actions.
